evidence_boundaries: The muon-imaging paper directly measures spatial and timing signals, while particle-species fractions and the few-GeV muon range rely mainly on GEANT4 and propagation thresholds rather than a direct muon spectrometer.
The QED sampler validates single-process distributions and fitted errors but has not been integrated into production PIC; no end-to-end speedup or cascade error is demonstrated.
The AI-GX temperature gains are numerical workflow results, and the highest surrogate score was an OOD configuration with non-nested magnetic surfaces rather than a valid design.
The largest warm-dense-aluminum model differences lie beyond the strongest experimental anchors; the 10 kT transport estimates are Drude/EH post-processing rather than magnetized mDFT.
No GEANT4, QED-PIC, GX/T3D, neural-network training or mDFT calculation was rerun locally.
